content.short: A User-friendly, Smart Contract enabled NFT Marketplace.
content.description: We're an NFT marketplace for all your favorite file types - JPGs, PNGs, SVGs and more! We're proud to be based on the Cardano blockchain, a cryptocurrency with the mission of providing financial infastructure for the unbanked. We hope that by continuing to innovate and bring new functionality to the CNFT space, we can help to move Cardano forward and support the community's novel humanitarian efforts. Our aim is to bring as much functionality and innovation to the CNFT space as possible.
content.meta: Find out about jpg.store (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
